messages.author: codex
messages.text:
Codex adversarial review: approve with notes.

Two findings:
1. [high] compile_commands include paths applied globally, not per-TU — sort+dedup discards scope and order. Can resolve to wrong header when two TUs have different -I roots with same-named headers. Filed as sutra/185.
2. [medium] C effect patterns use bare names (free, malloc, send) but starts_with matching overmatches (free_list, send_message). Fixed in 785afc3 — matching now requires :: boundary or exact match.

No correctness bugs in the adapter wiring, FCA impl, or pipeline integration. Pattern follows Rust/Dart adapters exactly.
